title: The Three Days and Two Deaths
description: Three Great Days stand within the whole of the soul's life, and there are two deaths. The first Day reaches from the descent of the divine humanity into the depths until its raising and the long refining that walks in the height. The second Day is the time when the interior states ordered by light come into their thrones in the new state of the soul and reign in the new aeon. The third and greatest Day is when the Lord shows his face fully, draws the soul into his hidden reserves, and the inmost is made new. The two deaths are the temporal mingling that ends at the great fire and the eternal severance from light, living air, and living soul.
